tutorial.access_details_body: Host is the address you enter in your game client. SSH is a secure administrative console channel — useful for advanced users to inspect logs or manually manage the machine.
tutorial.additional_params_body: Advanced parameters are passed directly into the game configuration. Use them if you need custom settings for a specific game server.
tutorial.create_vm_body: Here you choose a game and resources, and Playmox automatically provisions the machine and installs the server.
tutorial.disk_body: Disk usage is counted as the total allocated VM storage capacity, regardless of actual usage. It reserves space on the host for your machine.
tutorial.game_config_body: Game-specific parameters (e.g. server version, max players, world mode). Settings are saved and automatically applied.
tutorial.game_selection_body: Select a game (e.g. Minecraft) and an optional VM name. The name helps distinguish your servers on the list.
tutorial.launch_body: After creating the VM, Playmox starts background installation. The server will appear on the list, and its status will indicate when it is ready. Provisioning and installing components may take a few minutes.
tutorial.limits_body:
CPU, RAM, and instance count only count when a VM is running or being created/updated. A stopped VM does not consume compute limits.

Instance count defines how many VMs you can have running simultaneously.
tutorial.machine_row_body: Each row represents a separate game server. You can see its status, resources, and live game runtime information. The status shows whether the VM is running or applying changes.
tutorial.more_actions_body: The "three dots" menu contains advanced actions: game configuration, console/SSH, backups, reinstallation, resource management, and access credentials.
tutorial.public_ports_body: Public ports are counted only for active instances. Each game server consumes a specific number of ports shown during VM creation (SSH ports do not count toward the limit).
tutorial.quick_actions_body: Start, restart, graceful shutdown, and force stop — the core controls for your server.
tutorial.vm_resources_body: CPU, RAM, and disk are hard VM limits. They affect performance and how many servers you can run simultaneously within your quota.
tutorial.welcome_body: Welcome to the Playmox tutorial! You are looking at 3 sample VMs and demo resource limits. This preview does not modify your data — it helps you quickly understand the panel.
